derivation: simpa [cpt, Ideal.map_span] using (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (Algebra.TensorProduct.lift f.ofConv h.ofConv (fun _ _ => Commute.all _ _)) (hc₂ j))
explanation: The Mathlib lemma sends an element of an ideal into its image under a ring homomorphism. Apply it to `c₂ j ∈ span {p}` and the tensor-product lift; `Ideal.map_span` and preservation of natural-number casts simplify the image ideal to `span {p}`. The current proof instead applies the file-local `map_mem_span_natCast` helper.
